kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتمسكن (form IIq)
# أَتَمَسْكَنُ (ʔatamaskanu) /ʔa.ta.mas.ka.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# أَتَمَسْكَنَ (ʔatamaskana) /ʔa.ta.mas.ka.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# أَتَمَسْكَنْ (ʔatamaskan) /ʔa.ta.mas.kan/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
